findings.body: The exclusion only applies before findings are added. At src/forge/review.py:142, a finding citing plans/spotted.json puts it back into the fingerprint. If a review cites an existing spotted list, recording that finding or another new worker observation changes the list after the review fingerprint was saved. The next close reruns Autoreview, and forge-pr-check rejects the review as stale (src/forge/prcheck.py:175). Exclude spotted.PATH after combining both sets of paths, and cover a review that cites the list.
findings.title: Not done: recording never makes a review stale

findings.body: Validation accepts entries with backslash or absolute paths and untrimmed, repeated-whitespace text, provided their keys match those malformed values. Close therefore reviews and preserves a list that violates item 1's field-value contract instead of issuing the bad refusal. This is new evidence beyond the ruled key-consistency check: these keys match. Invalid UTF-8 also escapes read() at line 65 as UnicodeDecodeError rather than Unreadable, so check() supplies no repair. Validate the required path/text/item values and translate decoding failures into Unreadable; cover these cases through close.
findings.title: Not done: refuse every unreadable spotted list
